name: chief-of-staff
description: A Chief of Staff for your Claude desktop sessions: one session becomes the Chief, watches every other session, tells you which ones need you, and closes or answers them when you ask. A local console on 127.0.0.1 shows a live session graph, a roster, the Chief's chat and any session's transcript, with an optional local voice (Hey Chief).

stale_hours.title: Stale after (hours)
stale_hours.description: A session with no activity for this many hours counts as stale.

recent_days.title: Show sessions active in the last (days)
recent_days.description: The graph and roster show live sessions and sessions active in this many days; older ones collapse into one row.

speak_replies.title: Speak the Chief's replies
speak_replies.description: Read each Chief reply aloud through the local voice, when it is installed.

listen.title: Listening mode
listen.description: wake: always listening for the wake word. ptt: only while push-to-talk is held. off: no microphone.

voice.title: Voice
voice.description: auto uses what voice setup picked for this PC (Chatterbox on a GPU, Kokoro on a CPU). chatterbox or kokoro forces one; the other is the fallback.

wake_word.title: Wake word
wake_word.description: The phrase that starts listening in wake mode.

notify.title: Proactive notices
notify.description: Let the Chief speak up when a session starts waiting on you, finishes, or goes stale.

quiet_hours.title: Quiet hours
quiet_hours.description: No proactive notices in this local time range, like 22:00-07:00. Leave empty for none.
